title: Form Energy raises $750M to build more 100-hour batteries for the grid | TechCrunch
summary: Battery startup Form Energy said on Wednesday that it has raised $750 million to expand its manufacturing capacity in West Virginia, the latest sign that the AI data center building boom is fueling investment in energy storage.
